inspection_method: Direct creative-director review of every final PNG at original pixel resolution after the authored entrance choreography settled. This is visual judgment, separate from automated geometry and state assertions.

findings: All eight diagonal concept pairings retain distinct spatial and reading grammars at 520, 750, 975, and 1200 px.
Body copy remains readable and metadata remains visible in friendly, retro, basic, and glass treatments; dark and retro surfaces no longer lose secondary text.
No settled frame contains a mid-entrance opacity state, clipped prose, dense-header collision, or root overflow.
Pinned history and left artifact regions yield outside the requested Chat measure instead of compressing the transcript below usability.
Each questionnaire has a concept-specific composition, progress language, and motion origin rather than a shared renderer with a visual skin.
Dialogue Score, Branchbook, and Workshop were compacted after inspection so choices and bottom commit controls remain fully visible above the held-composer panel.
Question prompt, options, progress, cancel, skip, back, and forward actions are legible and spatially stable in all eight final frames.
The eight work compositions remain structurally distinct: publication notes, score, time bands, revision layers, instrument bench, strands, relay zones, and quiet register.
Dialogue Score and Workshop headers separate label, active summary, time, and state without collision; dense rows retain readable type and status contrast.
Persistent composers, work controls, progress, and scroll boundaries remain coherent without obscuring active content.

Artifact error, compact approval, material route warning, offline state, durable draft, route selection, all-thread search, Context Ring, pop-out, and deterministic-controller surfaces remain distinguishable and readable.
The 520 px route/search/context popups remain within the viewport and do not collide with their origin controls or hide their close action.
Prototype-only controller framing is explicit and does not visually impersonate the proposed production Chat surface.

cross_engine_spot_check.scope: Representative parity review only; this is not a claim that all 55 Chromium frames received direct visual inspection.
findings: Sampled Chromium frames preserve the Firefox layout geometry, type hierarchy, surface contrast, and settled authored state across all four theme families.
The repaired Dialogue Score questionnaire keeps all choices and commit controls above the held composer in Blink.
Workshop workbench, narrow route picker, and pop-out Context Ring remain readable and collision-free in Blink.

global_findings: All 55 final evidence frames were directly inspected; none is counted from an automated assertion alone.
The larger 512-cell baseline and 896-cell feature matrices remain automated geometry and state coverage and are not represented as human visual reviews.
No concept is ranked, selected, or implied as the winner.
residual_boundary: This receipt covers the browser concept evidence only. Native Slint, detached-window DPI, platform font metrics, IME, assistive technology, and live-service behavior remain production validation work.
